newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh banks to set own interest rate.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh banks to set own interest rate.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank (central bank) on Thursday said commercial banks were now free to set their own interest rates on deposits in a move to further relax its control over the banking sector.
A central bank statement said: "The Bangladesh Bank has decided to remove the minimum floor rate on deposit and the decision will be effective from February 19."
It said the commercial banks were allowed to fix their own interest rates under the country's banking sector reforms.
"This is a good step and there will now be market-driven interest rates," one official with a foreign bank said.
